name: Orbit AI - Phase 5 - Demo extension auto-assignment (W5.3)

nodes.name: Demo extension assign webhook
nodes.notes: W5.3: 'Demo extension auto-assignment (1000+).' Fire-and-forget caller, same pattern as opening-line-tracking.workflow.json - the calling workflow (demo-generation-trigger.workflow.json, wired this pass) doesn't wait on this. Input: {locationId}. Lets a prospect call the shared Telnyx demo line and dial their own extension to reach their specific business's AI receptionist demo - see demo-extension-inbound-call.workflow.json for the other half (the inbound lookup).

nodes.name: Allocate extension
nodes.notes: POSTs with no body - the counter is global (command-center/src/messaging/db.ts's allocateDemoExtension), not scoped to anything this workflow provides. Reuses the ALERTS_INGEST_SECRET machine-auth credential like every other n8n-to-Command-Center call. A real atomic compare-and-swap on D1, not a guessed increment - see that function's own notes for why Twenty CRM's REST API wasn't used for this counter (no confirmed atomic-increment primitive there, same gap flagged in hopper-request-next's claim race-condition notes).

nodes.name: Write extension to Location
nodes.notes: New field this pass, CRM-OBJECT-MODEL.md's Location object. Once written, demo-extension-inbound-call.workflow.json can resolve an inbound DTMF-dialed extension back to this Location.

nodes.name: Alert: demo extension assigned

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ severity: 'info', source: 'demo-generation', message: 'Demo extension ' + $('Allocate extension').item.json.extension + ' assigned - dial ' + ($env.TELNYX_DEMO_LINE_NUMBER || 'PLACEHOLDER_TELNYX_DEMO_LINE_NUMBER') + ' ext. ' + $('Allocate extension').item.json.extension + ' to hear it live.', linkUrl: ($env.TWENTY_CRM_BASE_URL || '') + '/objects/location/' + $('Demo extension assign webhook').item.json.body.locationId }) }}

nodes.notes: Routes to #demos (alertRouting.ts matches 'demo-generation' - same source string demo-generation-trigger.workflow.json's own alerts use, since this is the same demo-readiness event from the rep's point of view, just the phone-reachable half of it).
